en: Black‑and‑white night view of a long, arcaded building with repeated stone arches and columns running in perspective. A band of bright horizontal lights traces the façade above the arches, giving the structure a modern, illuminated look. Large display windows and glass doors line the ground floor; above one entrance is a round clock and a decorative emblem. The pavement in front is broad and mostly empty. The photo has white, slightly wavy edges consistent with vintage postcard paper.
